summary: Gray Media, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $750 million aggregate principal of 7.500% senior secured first lien notes due 2034 under an indenture dated August 21, 2026, with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. The notes were issued at par in a private placement. Net proceeds will redeem $675 million of its 10.500% 2029 notes, repay $21 million of revolving credit borrowings, and cover fees and call premium. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
